 Life is moving faster than ever across most areas of human activity, and that is something you need to make use of this year. Don’t follow those who try to put up barriers to progress because they won’t succeed. Instead, embrace chaos and thrive. 
 ARIES (March 21 - April 20):
 No matter who tells you what this week, even if it is someone you trust, you must check the facts for yourself. The more you take for granted the more likely it is that a small error could evolve into a much larger one, so stay sharp.
 TAURUS (April 21 - May 21):
 There will be a lot of coming and going this week and it may frustrate you that so many people are moving at speed when all you want to do is stay where you are and relax. So what’s stopping you? No one can force you to take part.
 GEMINI (May 22 - June 21):
 If it appears that someone is trying to undermine your authority you must do something about it. If you don’t stand up to them immediately they may take it as a sign they can get away with this sort of thing indefinitely. Don’t let that happen.
 CANCER (June 22 - July 23):
 There is no reason why you should feel guilty about something that was in no way your fault. If someone you do business with tries to drag you into the frame you must resist and you must let them know you have no intention of being a scapegoat. 
 LEO (July 24 - Aug. 23):
 It may seem as if you have got the rough end of a deal, and maybe in the short-term you have, but the planets suggest everything will balance out in the end. Stay calm and refuse to panic, but do take defensive action if you get the chance.
 VIRGO (Aug. 24 - Sept. 23):
 You may be falling behind in your schedule but it’s no big deal, so don’t worry. The next few days should be special when it comes to your social life, so by all means put your work on hold for a while (but not too long).
 LIBRA (Sept. 24 - Oct. 23):
 If you can find a way to bring a dispute to a harmonious end then do so. If, however, you have no choice but to declare one side the winner and the other side the loser then do that instead. Why should you care if anyone feels offended?
 SCORPIO (Oct. 24 - Nov. 22):
 The most important thing over the coming week is that you make all the big decisions yourself. If you let other people take control, even in small ways, most likely they will mess it up and cause you problems that could have been avoided.
 SAGITTARIUS (Nov. 23 - Dec. 21):
 You have never been the sort to let other people’s negative thinking affect you in any way and that’s good because there will be a lot of doom and gloom merchants plying their trade over the next few days. Your world is fine and about to become fantastic!
 CAPRICORN (Dec. 22 - Jan. 20):
 There is a danger you could take some situations too seriously and paint yourself into a corner you find it hard to get out of. No matter what occurs, either in your private life or in your career, always act on the assumption that it’s all a game.
 AQUARIUS (Jan. 21 - Feb. 19):
 It may seem as if you are moving in a radically different direction to most of the people around you but why should that be a problem? You are at your best when following pathways that lesser mortals don’t even know exist. That’s your special power.
 PISCES (Feb. 20 - Mar. 20):
 Instead of listening to what the so-called “experts” tell you this week listen instead to what your inner voice is trying to say. Deep down you already know the answers to the questions that really matter, and those that don’t matter can be safely ignored.
